as_told.title: Chrome-plated BB-like object spat out of nose, possibly an implant

plain: In 1964, a man says he had a sinus problem, blew his nose, and a tiny metal ball like a BB came out. A witness named Richard Barth tells Michels this happened to him: "a BB came out, little round ball with a flat side on it." He tells it on an episode about a nuclear missile guard who says he was abducted. A researcher on the same episode, who is not named, describes it as not a copper BB but "chrome plated or something." That speaker places it years after childhood and suggests it was an implant, meaning an object some say abductors put inside people's bodies. If so, the ball would be a physical leftover of an abduction.
